question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a **Voltrieve Fjord AWD**, the service guide says a **complete front brake replacement on one side** needs these items: 1 brake disc for the side being worked on, 1 brake pad set for the front axle, 1 brake caliper for the side, 1 caliper carrier for the side, 1 brake hose for the side, 1 pad wear sensor for the side, 1 caliper fitting kit for the front axle, 1 brake dust shield for the side, and 1 bottle of brake fluid DOT 4 LV. It also says Fjord front brake parts differ by drive, and **AWD uses 370 mm parts**. *(voltrieve-service-guide.md)*

The spare parts catalog gives these article numbers for the **Fjord AWD front left** corner and related front-axle items:  

- **VP-10072** - Brake disc, front left, 370 mm ventilated brake disc. *(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **VP-10254** - Brake pad set, front axle, set of 4 pads for the 370 mm disc, covers both sides of the axle. *(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **VP-10345** - Brake caliper, front left, twin piston floating caliper for the 370 mm disc. *(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **VP-10527** - Caliper carrier, front left, carrier bracket for the floating caliper. *(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **VP-10631** - Brake hose, front left, reinforced flexible hose with banjo fitting. *(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **VP-10670** - Pad wear sensor, front left, electrical pad wear sensor. *(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **VP-10709** - Caliper fitting kit, front axle, slide pins, bolts and anti-rattle clips for one side. *(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **VP-10761** - Brake dust shield, front left, pressed steel shield. *(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*
- **VP-15168** - Brake fluid DOT 4 LV, 1 litre bottle. *(voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)*

question: brakes-lumen
